latest_news.headline: Iran fires new 100kg warhead missile at Tel Aviv - unprecedented type in war
latest_news.text: Iranian missile with 100kg warhead hits Tel Aviv - 'something we have not yet encountered in the war' per IDF Col. Miki David. Major building damage, 6+ casualties. New warhead type suggests Iran conserving advanced munitions for sustained campaign.

latest_news.headline: 6 Iranian ballistic missiles hit Kurdistan Iraq - 6 killed, 30 wounded
latest_news.text: Two volleys of Iranian ballistic missiles struck Kurdistan Region of Iraq at dawn. 6 Kurdish fighters killed, 30 wounded. KRG condemns 'in strongest terms.' Geographic expansion of Iranian strikes beyond Gulf/Israel.

latest_news.headline: Lebanon expels Iran ambassador - orders departure by March 29
latest_news.text: Lebanon withdraws approval of Iran's ambassador Sheibani, declares persona non grata, gives until March 29 to leave. Cites 'Iran's violation of diplomatic norms.' Major diplomatic break between Lebanon and its traditional patron.

latest_news.headline: Central Beirut struck overnight - 10 killed, 27 injured, no warnings issued
latest_news.text: Israeli strikes hit central Beirut overnight without warnings. At least 10 killed, 27 injured. Geographic expansion into heart of Lebanese capital after strikes on southern suburbs.

latest_news.headline: IDF destroys 330 of 470 Iranian missile launchers - program 70%+ degraded
latest_news.text: ISW reports IDF has destroyed or rendered inaccessible ~330 of Iran's ~470 ballistic missile launchers. Launch volume down 90% from war start. Iran may be conserving remaining missiles for prolonged war.

latest_news.headline: Pakistan ceasefire EXPIRED - Operation Ghazab Lil Haq resuming
latest_news.text: Eid ceasefire expired midnight PKT with no extension. FM Dar: committed to eradicating terrorism. Pakistan 'in no hurry to end operation.' Taliban retaliation threats continue.

latest_news.headline: Red Cross warns 'irreversible consequences' from nuclear facility attacks
latest_news.text: ICRC President Mirjana Spoljaric: 'Most alarming is potential harm to nuclear facilities' with 'irreversible consequences.' US/Israel struck Bushehr, Natanz, Fordow. Iran struck near Dimona. Dimona/Arad casualty toll now 180+.
